Internal helper: a table's widths and sizes, fitted to the page

Source: R/tables.R
dot-jst_docx_fit.Rd

Ruling R55 (Session 404): a table wider than its page loses half its number columns' padding; then its labels wrap onto at most two lines, the stub narrowing as far as .jst_docx_stub_floor() allows; then its font steps down a point at a time to 8 pt, the stub at each size allowed its floor again; then the stub narrows to an inch and a half and every column in proportion. A number never wraps until that last step. The notes step down with the table; the caption keeps its size. (Until Session 405 the font stepped down before any label wrapped – Session 402, item 11, settled on a 17-column regression table whose numbers set its width.)

Usage

.jst_docx_fit(tbl, style, page_text)

Arguments

tbl

A jst_table.

style

The style list.

page_text

The text width available, in dxa.

Value

A list: widths (integer), size and note_size (points).
